# A star to catch: five chunky spikes round a faceted core, 0.7 m across, in the XZ plane (facing
# the camera), unlit peach. Pooled game bone; the game spins and pops it. Origin at the centre.
new
material new Star --base-color 0.9843 0.7333 0.6784 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Core --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.17 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 0.7 1
apply --scale
add mesh cone --name S0 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.11 --radius2 0 --depth 0.26 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 0.6 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0.0 0
set location 0.000 0 0.200
add mesh cone --name S1 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.11 --radius2 0 --depth 0.26 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 0.6 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -72.0 0
set location -0.190 0 0.062
add mesh cone --name S2 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.11 --radius2 0 --depth 0.26 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 0.6 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -144.0 0
set location -0.118 0 -0.162
add mesh cone --name S3 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.11 --radius2 0 --depth 0.26 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 0.6 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -216.0 0
set location 0.118 0 -0.162
add mesh cone --name S4 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.11 --radius2 0 --depth 0.26 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 0.6 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -288.0 0
set location 0.190 0 0.062
select all
material assign Star
active Core
join
rename Core Star
select all
shade flat
export star.glb
